subject: music
title: Time Signatures
welcome_lead: What the two numbers at the start of music mean.
final_note: Top number = beats. Bottom number = note type.

concepts.def: Two numbers showing beats in each bar.
Four crotchet beats per bar — most common.
Three crotchet beats per bar — waltz.

walkthroughs.body_html: The top number tells you how many beats are in each bar. The bottom number tells you what type of note gets one beat (4 = crotchet, 8 = quaver).
4/4 means four crotchet beats per bar. It's called common time because most pop, rock and dance music uses it.
3/4 means three crotchets per bar. Count ONE-two-three, ONE-two-three. This is the waltz feel — Strauss's Blue Danube is in 3/4.
